notes.title: Updated Store & Library Graphical Assets
notes.content:
In order to take advantage of Valve's recent support for larger graphical assets, as well as their encouragement to do so, we have updated Ultra Mission's store and library assets with larger resolutions.

No other changes have been made at this time.

notes.title: Update Notes for 11/10/2023
notes.content:
- Analog stick now supported in main menu.
- Game now pauses automatically if gamepad is disconnected.
- Minor graphical tweaks have been implemented.
- 64-bit processor and operating system are now required.

notes.title: DualShock 4 and DualSense gamepads are now supported in Ultra Mission™!
notes.content:
[h1]Expanded Gamepad Support[/h1]

There has never been a better time to blast than right now! [b]Ultra Mission™[/b] has been updated to better support various gamepads, including Sony's [i]DualShock 4[/i] and [i]DualSense[/i] controllers.

The following gamepads are now supported by the Steam version of Ultra Mission™:

[list]
[*]Xbox One Controller
[*]Xbox Series X|S Controller
[*]Other XInput Gamepads
[*]DualSense
[*]DualShock 4*
[/list]
[i]*Does not support vibration[/i]
